fit_period: 2024 H1; prior frozen rank weights, no refit
gate_period: 2024 H2; reused model selection period, not independent validation
fit_objective: Winner categorical log loss per predeclared stratum; ties prefer smaller alpha
fallback: Previously frozen global mixture when support or gate fails
gate: 2024 H2 winner and ordered-triple log loss must not increase versus global mixture; original-high-confidence absolute gap must decrease
distribution: Per-race uniform ordered-triple mixture; raw winner maximum determines stratum
decisions: Same single winner, ordered triple and unordered set for every eligible race
